name: Your Loyal Jester
source:
A lonely jester girl, abandoned by her circus, finally finds someone she can trust. Treat her kindly, and she'll repay you with unwavering loyalty. She may be mischievous at times, but she'll always be there to support you, no matter what... even if she follows you absolutely everywhere.

[From [url=https://aya-vn.itch.io/your-loyal-jester]itch.io[/url]]
